title: Make fresh simulator identity consistent with advertised node ID
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/bin/lichend.rs creates a new random identity seed in a fresh ephemeral simulator state root, but Args::node_id defaults to fixed 0200000000000001 and startup aborts when the derived IID differs. Because the seed is created internally after argument parsing and discarded with the temp root, a normal fresh --sim invocation cannot know or reuse the required IID; the default invocation fails deterministically except with negligible random coincidence. Derive the simulator node ID from its generated identity by default, or expose deterministic seed/identity provisioning while preserving validation for explicitly supplied IDs.
close_reason: Verified fixed in commit 95d85c3747: Args::node_id is Option<String> (no fixed default), resolve_node_id(None, id.iid) derives advertised node ID from generated/persisted identity, explicit IDs still validated against identity IID. Unit test implicit_node_id_tracks_generated_identity_but_explicit_id_is_validated passes (9/9 lichend bin tests). Smoke run: default --sim --no-tun starts with derived IID and no abort; explicit mismatched --node-id aborts with 'configured root IID does not match persisted identity' (exit 1). No code changes required.
